prompt: [PASTE Ultimate Template body from Imagine Prompt Master — must explicitly reference last-frame visual/emotional state]
last_frame_recap: REPLACE: Detailed visual + emotional state of the approved last frame (composition, lighting, character pose/expression, camera, environment continuity).

momentum_vector.action: REPLACE: continuing action from previous clip
momentum_vector.camera: REPLACE: continuing camera trajectory and lens behavior
momentum_vector.physics_notes: REPLACE: rain, fabric, particle, contact, or environmental continuity notes

audio_momentum_vector.energy: REPLACE: overall energy level and curve
audio_momentum_vector.spatial: REPLACE: L/R/center placement of key elements

video_pipeline_spec: [VIDEO_PIPELINE_SPEC: model="grok-imagine-video-1.5", version="1.5", resolution="720p", clip_length="8-12s", native_audio=true, reference_image_fidelity=high, extend_protocol="LAST_FRAME + MOTION_VECTOR + AUDIO_CUE", stitch_priority=high, audio_momentum=true]
sound_layer: REPLACE: Native audio Sound Layer description that continues previous clip energy, tone, and spatial layout.

quota_optimization.rationale: Pure extend-from-frame chain. No new independent generation. Preserves identity lock and reduces total billed seconds.

quota_note: Extend-only path. Estimated cost based on clip length @ 1.5. 15% buffer protected.
return_path: artifacts/sequences/PROJECT/THIS_CLIP → RUN CHAIN QA → extract new last_frame → update momentum vectors → Sequence Director health check
handoff_steps: 1. Confirm source last_frame exists and passed previous Chain QA
2. Inject LAST_FRAME_RECAP + MOMENTUM_VECTOR + AUDIO_MOMENTUM_VECTOR into the prompt
3. Execute image_to_video / native extend on target surface using the approved last_frame as primary reference
4. On success → extract new last_frame + refresh momentum vectors
5. Run mandatory 10-point Chain QA before any further extension or stitch
6. Return updated packet + artifacts to Sequence Director / Studio Director
dna_inject: [OPTIONAL: Character DNA / Identity Lock inject block]
